<!-- See CONTRIBUTING.md for the full rules. One app per line; several apps from the same author go in one PR. -->

- [ ] The entry links to the public source repository
- [ ] The repository has a LICENSE file
- [ ] The project has a tagged release or build instructions in its README
- [ ] The entry follows the `- [Name](url) - Description.` format and is in alphabetical order within its section
- [ ] The description is one sentence of at most about 120 characters
- Author of this app: yes / no (either is fine)
